rationale: The task requires identifying which genome build a chr20 VCF uses by performing reproducible allele/coordinate checks. The selected skills provide access to UCSC genome data (including hg18/hg19/hg38/T2T tracks and sequences), chromosome-level sequence retrieval for reference allele validation, and Ensembl sequence retrieval for cross-checking coordinates. These capabilities directly support comparing VCF reference alleles against build-specific chromosome 20 sequences to determine the correct assembly.
